description:
This is a Sources Sought/Request for Information for a potential requirement the Marine Corps requires for Portable Latrines and Handwashing Stations at multiple locations in Arizona.

Please refer to the attached Performace Work Statement (PWS) for the dates, locations, description of services, etc.

This is not a solicitation. No quotes, proposals, bids, or submission(s) of any kind will be accepted in response to this Sources Sought/Request for Information.

If any portion of the PWS requires clarification, a clairfication email can be sent to the contracting office.
